review.why: Plans drip, nurture and onboarding email sequences, with triggers, timing, exits and a scripted quality score.
review.summary: Asks for sequence type, audience and goal, then produces a sequence overview, a block per email (timing, subject, preview, body, CTA, conditions) and a metrics plan. A bundled Python analyzer scores pacing, subject variety, CTA consistency and exit coverage, and anything under 70 is fixed. Proactive triggers cover low conversion and weak clicks.
strengths: Entry trigger and exit conditions are required for every sequence
Ready-to-send drafts with three subject-line alternatives
Diagnoses click problems in the body and CTA before blaming subject lines
cautions: The core principles section is only a pointer to a playbook file not read here
Email platforms are listed without setup help
